### God and Authority
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/god-and-authority-one-year-devotions-for-men-july-26.html
Passage: Numbers 17:4-5
Points:
- People often resent rules and authority, yet ordered leadership is necessary to prevent lawlessness and chaos.
- Israel's grumbling against Moses and Aaron was viewed by the Lord as rebellion against Himself.
- God miraculously caused Aaron's dry staff to blossom and bear fruit to unmistakably vindicate His appointed leader.
- Aaron was set apart not because his wooden rod was special, but because of God's sovereign calling.
- Pursuing total autonomy and doing whatever seems right in our own eyes leads quickly to spiritual ruin.

### Devotional: Numbers 17–18
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/numbers-17-18-psalm-55-isaiah-7-james-1/
Passage: Numbers 17:1-13
Points:
- God settled the rebellion against the priesthood by causing Aaron's rod alone to sprout buds, blossoms, and almonds.
- Israel realized their rebellion was against the living God, but their terrified reaction revealed cringing fear rather than genuine devotion.
- The miraculous sign failed to produce lasting repentance, demonstrating how quickly powerful spiritual moments can dissipate.
- God's strict requirement for an appointed priest underscores that only divinely ordained mediation is acceptable before Him.
- Aaron's calling anticipates Christ, the ultimate High Priest who alone takes away sin and grants safe access to God.
